meta.what: Every NHL club roster as the NHL published it on the day read, plus every 2025-26 regular season skater and goalie line. Written by scripts/fetchNhlFoRoster.mjs; scripts/genNhlFrontOfficeRoster.mjs turns it into src/data/nhlFoRosters2026.ts offline.

espnSpotCheck.rule: the 6th, 12th, 18th, 24th and 30th clubs in alphabetical order of abbreviation, and on each the first ten kept men in alphabetical order of surname then first name
espnSpotCheck.bar: stop and report if more than 2 of the men checked disagree
